## Which file and section

File name and the heading or line you are correcting.

## What it currently says

Quote or paraphrase the part you think is wrong.

## What you saw instead

What actually happened on your own store, and what you would expect the file to say.

## How you know

A store you ran, a test you did, or a documented change from Google, WordPress or WooCommerce. Link the source if there is one.

## Context (optional)

Platform and versions, catalogue size, or anything else that changes whether the guidance applies.
